01

About Sarvlekh

Who we are and why the name matters.

What is Sarvlekh?

Sarvlekh is a premium business systems studio. We design the software, accounting and operating systems that run hostels, clinics, schools, plants, stores, hotels and 20+ other kinds of business — all connected in one place.

What does the name Sarvlekh mean?

Sarvlekh comes from Sanskrit: "sarva" means all and "lekh" means record or writing. It means the record of everything — the promise that every part of your business is written down clearly and kept in order.

Which businesses does Sarvlekh serve?

We serve hostels, PGs, clinics, messes, laundries, schools, coaching institutes, media houses, finance companies, Tally and accounting firms, RMC plants, manufacturing plants, retail stores, wholesalers, gyms, restaurants, showrooms, hotels, weighbridges and mines — and many more on request.

Is Sarvlekh a premium service?

Yes. We work with a limited number of businesses at a time and give each one close attention, tailored design and long-term support rather than a one-size-fits-all package.

02

Services & how we work

How we work, step by step.

What does "a system that makes a system" mean?

We do not hand you a fixed product. We build a flexible core platform, then shape modules, workflows and reports around how your business actually works, so the system grows when your business grows.

Does Sarvlekh also provide accounting services?

Yes. Along with software we offer bookkeeping, Tally, GST, TDS, payroll and MIS services, connected to your operations so entries are made once.

How does Sarvlekh reduce labour and worker hours?

By replacing manual registers, repeated entries, phone-call coordination and month-end scrambles with automated workflows, reminders and live dashboards.

How long does implementation take?

A focused first release typically goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work, then expand in stages without disrupting daily operations.

Can you migrate our existing data?

Yes. We import data from spreadsheets, Tally and older software, validate it with you and keep a rollback copy.

03

Technology & security

Where your data lives and how it stays safe.

Is Sarvlekh software mobile friendly?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is designed phone-first, with separate mobile layouts and apps for staff, customers, parents and field teams.

Is our business data secure?

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is role-based and every sensitive action is logged. Backups run automatically.

Does the system work offline?

Field-facing apps such as billing, orders and weighment work offline and sync automatically when the connection returns.

Which tools can Sarvlekh integrate with?

Tally, GST systems, UPI and payment gateways, WhatsApp, SMS, email, biometric devices, GPS, barcode scanners and weighbridge indicators, among others.

04

Getting started

The first conversation, and what follows.

How do I start working with Sarvlekh?

Email connect@sarvlekh.in with a few lines about your business. We will set up a discovery conversation, map your workflows and propose a clear first release.

What happens in the first conversation?

We listen first. In a short discovery call we learn how your business runs, where time is lost and what a calm version would look like — then we share a clear scope and timeline.

Do you support us after launch?

Yes. Every engagement includes onboarding, training and ongoing support, with optional monthly improvement reviews.
